auxiliary_role: frozen supporting evidence; post-blind use only

aux_r06_policy.method: Pairwise-complete analysis per cell and explicit valid denominator. Missing values stay missing; no imputation and no global downweight.
aux_r06_policy.reason: The small coverage gap is not evidence of poor judgment quality.

aux_r08_policy.allowed_use: Preserve unchanged and report as a separately labeled sensitivity perspective.
aux_r08_policy.prohibited_use: Do not include in strong-support thresholds, consensus counts, majority summaries, Core overrides, or automatic adjudication.
aux_r08_policy.reason: Near-total avoidance of NO makes the scale non-comparable with both Core anchors and the other Auxiliary reviewers; its inclusion would mechanically bias support toward PLAUSIBLE/CLEAR.

aux_consensus: unique strict majority (>50%) among valid AUX-R01..R07; otherwise MIXED; descriptive supporting evidence only
astra_execution: isolated fresh-context model judge; no parent conversation or human evidence

reason_codes.EXPLICIT: Emotion or defining feature is explicitly expressed.
reason_codes.CONTEXT_ENTAILED: Defining feature is strongly supported by context.
reason_codes.BORDERLINE: Reasonable reading with incomplete or ambiguous defining support.
reason_codes.INTENSITY: Intensity is insufficient or borderline for the target definition.
reason_codes.EVENT_ONLY: An event is described without support for this emotion.
reason_codes.OTHER_EMOTION: The text supports a different emotion, not this defining feature.
reason_codes.NEGATED: The target emotion is negated or contradicted.
reason_codes.ATTRIBUTION: Only another person or a hypothetical voice expresses it.

human_reveal_gate: all Astra cells validated and sealed before comparison generation; never reveal to Luna input
luna_input: byte-identical semantic CSV; same guidance and output vocabulary
snapshot_use: Existing audit snapshots only, hash-checked; necessary for text/definitions and missing/tail metadata absent from disagreement tables
text_integrity_limitation: Uses frozen audited text snapshots unchanged; historical UI quote-rendering concern is not independently resolved here.
